description:
Transform, keyframe, rename, nest or lock GROUPS. A group moves, scales, rotates and fades as ONE unit without touching children's stored positions: a camera push instead of building the layout twice.

- Address by `group_id` (from get_clip select:['groups'], or returned by add_elements/update_elements with `group`), never by name; an unknown id is an error. No add_groups: create a group by adding elements with `group: "<name>"` (its pivot comes from its children's box).
- Units: offset_px, blur_px, anchor_px canvas px; scale multiplier; rotation/rotate degrees; opacity 0-100.
- anchor_px: the pivot, a canvas point (default the children's box centre; reply gives the stored fraction + box). Stored as a fraction of the members' box, so re-set it after changing a transformed group's membership.
- Only fields you pass change. keyframes: [] clears every track; omitted = unchanged; a list replaces the WHOLE track of each property it names (to change one keyframe, send all of that property's, read from get_clip groups). parent_group_id: "" → clip root.
- Keyframable: offsetX, offsetY, scaleX, scaleY, rotation, rotateX, rotateY, opacity, blur. Position, size and colour belong to elements.

  update_groups({ project_id, items: [{ clip_index: 2, group_id, anchor_px: [960, 540],
    keyframes: [{ timestamp: 0, scaleX: 1, scaleY: 1 }, { timestamp: 1.2, scaleX: 2.4, scaleY: 2.4, offsetX: -400, offsetY: -120, interpolation: "easeOut" }] }] })

Concurrency: clip-scoped; serialize against other writes on the same clip; other clips/projects run in parallel.

items.description: One entry per group to update

anchor_px.description: The pivot, as a canvas-pixel point. Defaults to the centre of the group's child bounding box.

blur_px.description: Blur in pixels, applied over every child

collapsed.description: Collapse the group in the editor's layer tree

group_id.description: The group's id (from get_clip, or returned by add_elements when you pass `group`)

insert_at.description: Z-order: moves the whole group as a block; members keep their order. 'front'/'back' of its scope, or {before|after: element or group id} (taking that node's parent).

keyframes.description: Animate the group over time. [] clears every track; omit to leave tracks alone.

blur.description: blur in pixels, applied over every child

interpolation.description: Easing for THIS entry, applied to every property in it (default easeInOut).

offsetX.description: offsetX in canvas pixels — how far to move the whole group

offsetY.description: offsetY in canvas pixels — how far to move the whole group

opacity.description: 0-100, multiplied over each child's own opacity

scaleX.description: scaleX multiplier (1 = unscaled), about the group's anchor

scaleY.description: scaleY multiplier (1 = unscaled), about the group's anchor

timestamp.description: Clip seconds, ≥0 (0 = the clip's first frame)

locked.description: Lock the group in the editor

name.description: Rename the group. Names stay unique per clip, so a collision is rejected.

offset_px.description: Move the whole group by [dx, dy] canvas pixels. Children's stored positions are untouched.

opacity.description: 0-100, multiplied over each child's own opacity

parent_group_id.description: Nest this group under another by id. "" moves it to the clip root. Omit to leave the parent alone.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees about the anchor

scale.description: Scale [x, y] as a multiplier about the anchor (1 = unscaled)

returning.description: Valid returning options: 'ids', 'layout', 'qa', 'qa.codes'. 'geometry' is not an option; use 'layout' for measured placement, or read element dimensions with get_clip. Response shape (like get_clip `select`). Omitted: ids + layout + compact clip audit. 'ids': element_id per item. 'layout': measured text fit (font_size_px, text_width_px, natural_width_px, line_count, fits_width/fits_height/fits; widen to natural_width_px, not text_width_px; `adjusted` when the measured height replaced yours) + placement {y_anchor, top, center, bottom} (compare placement.center with a container's centre). 'qa.codes': audit severity/code/element_ids; 'qa': + message and fix. Always returned: failed items, font_warnings, audit errors ([] → {total, succeeded, failed} + {clip_index, errors: [{code, element_ids}]}). Bleed under a keyframed group = warning (camera_move).

name: update_groups
title: Update groups
